_note: Written by scripts/art/ui/talk_window.mjs --pieces: do not edit by hand. The talk window (D23, D126 to D128), the RuneScape way (Michael, 2026-11-20): a box in the bottom left, one line at a time, in the window's pixels, 1152 x 648; "at" is a top left corner, and a piece's "at" already counts its shadow. Text is drawn by Godot: "at" is the top left of the line (the top is the font's ascent line), "centre" its top middle. Every place and size here is a setting. The conversation's choices are not decided: every name, line and reply in the draft is made up. In another window size the box would keep to the bottom left (not done).

line._note: Someone speaks: Panel, then on their side Portrait Back, their head (their character's head and shoulders facing "facing", twice the size, cut to a circle of "radius" round "centre", the shop's way) and Portrait Ring; their name, their line wrapped to "width" (at most "most_lines"), "Click here to continue", each centred on that side's text_centre_x. The other side stays empty. A click anywhere on the box, or Space, goes on. The speaker is "left"; you are "right", named "You" (a newborn has nobody's name, D31).

options._note: Your replies: Panel, "Select an option", then one line per reply, "N. words", centred on centre_x, "step" apart (at most "most"); a click or the number key picks one. The pointed one: Option Lit behind it (drawn for the first line: move it down by step times its place) and its words in "on". In a list of people (D127, D128), how you know each one follows in brackets, in "kind", "kind_dy" lower.
